column1: # Batch 36 — usa: what shipped and was then taken out, kept as data.

column3: Re-reads the Socrata catalogue SOCRATA_NY_STATE already reads: the same /api/views.json, the same records keyed on the same view id, stored a second time under a second source id. The two looked different only because one asked limit=200 and the other limit=100; once both page the whole catalogue at limit=1000 the endpoints are identical and lint-sources flags them. The older row is kept (hand-written description).
